why: The EPO OPS adapter tests replay recorded responses instead of synthetic XML. Only refusal responses could be recorded here: the claims endpoint answers 403 without OAuth and the token endpoint answers 401 without a client identifier, so no authenticated claims response exists yet. Run scripts/record_epo_ops_fixture.py with EPO_OPS_KEY and EPO_OPS_SECRET to add claims_<number>.xml, which turns the replay test from skip to run.

claims_EP4334731_403.xml.note: refusal recorded from the live endpoint with no OAuth token; this is what an unauthenticated request returns
